reason: Our last exam asked how we use AI. We answered with an inventory and a policy memo, and nobody has asked how we control customer agents' trades. No regulator requires this yet, so I can't justify an unaudited startup sitting inline on our order flow, even for free.
objection: You have no customers and no SOC 2. If I put you in front of execution, our own vendor due diligence fails before the examiner ever looks, and the LOI that names a price after the pilot is a commitment I don't sign for an optional control.
would_change_my_mind: An exam finding or written regulator guidance that specifically asks how we govern and stop customer AI agents trading in their accounts.
